Name: DE-Holidays
Statement:
select  hol.Date as Day,
        com.Oid as CompanyId,
        com.Name as Company,
        hol.Oid as HolidayId,
        hol.Name as Holiday,
        hol.ModifiedOn
from    Holiday hol
            left join Company com on com.Oid = hol.Company
where   (@ModifiedFrom is null or hol.ModifiedOn >= @ModifiedFrom)
